articles.title: Binance co-founders CZ and Yi He adopted Simpsons cartoon aliases ‘Homer’ and ‘Marge’ in company meetings
articles.snippet: Yi, who is now the co-CEO of Binance alongside its other chief Richard Teng, still uses the name Marge in meetings and chats.

articles.title: Strategy cuts net leverage to near zero as cash nearly matches convertible debt
articles.snippet: The bitcoin treasury company has built nearly four years of preferred-dividend coverage while continuing to repurchase STRC below par.

articles.title: Zerohash back for second effort at OCC trust bank charter
articles.snippet: The crypto infrastructure firm failed to get approval when it first sought a U.S. charter, and the company is quickly back with what it said would be a narrower effort.

articles.title: Protocol upgrade decouples consensus from execution to solve scaling bottlenecks
articles.snippet: CTDG Dev Hub participant’s protocol upgrade decouples consensus from execution, allowing network nodes to reach agreement on blocks before transaction execution completes.

articles.title: Solana Treasury Firm Invites Investors to Look 'Beyond the Price of SOL'
articles.snippet: Nasdaq-listed SOL treasury company DeFi Development Corp launched a free network dashboard on Wednesday. Its pitch: judge Solana on more than just price.
